Article 5 (Submission of Opinions and Reporting)
(1) A person who has an opinion on a bill subject to prior announcement of legislation may submit the opinion to the competent committee during the prior announcement period in writing or by posting it on the National Assembly or committee website. [The supplied Korean source contains corrupted characters in the expression describing the bill subject to prior announcement; confirm the original before final legal approval.]
(2) The expert adviser to the competent committee shall report to the committee or subcommittee any important matters among opinions submitted under paragraph (1), including matters concerning the structure of the bill, its scope of application and whether it infringes upon equity.
